title: Introduce the HIT Directory in the WhatsApp band
userRequest:
## Summary Add a short teaser for the **HIT Directory (beta)**. The teaser says the directory is a feature of the alumni WhatsApp community and encourages people to join. The site does not mention the directory today. This is a teaser only (user, 2026-10-15): "We don't want to reveal all the information just yet — we just want to say it's a feature in the WhatsApp and encourage folks to join." So the site does **not** publish the access number, the "hit" keyword, or step-by-step usage. ## Key Decisions - **It goes in the homepage WhatsApp band (`#community`), not on a new page.** The directory lives inside the WhatsApp community, so the teaser is one more reason to join, right next to "Apply to join." - **Placement:** a quiet note in the `wa-invite` column, under the lede. It belongs with the invitation (why join), not in the How-to-join procedure. It stays visually secondary to the Apply button: no second button, no new link. - **Copy (draft):** "**New: the HIT Directory (beta).** Members can now find fellow alumni and request introductions right inside our WhatsApp community. Apply to join to get access." - It names the feature and one line of what it does, then points to joining. - It gives no phone number, no keyword, and no WhatsApp link. That keeps the existing no-WhatsApp-links rule (`isWhatsAppGroupLink`, `noPersonalEmail.test.ts`) intact with nothing to weigh. - **The copy is a component prop with a default**, so scenarios can override or blank it. A blank value renders no note, which is the off switch until the full launch. - **No credit to the lead on the site.** ## Out of scope (future) - Moving every WhatsApp join form to the new app's process. The user expects this later, but the new process isn't ready. `WHATSAPP_FORM_URL` and the "Apply to join" flow stay exactly as they are. - Publishing the access number and keyword. That waits for the full launch. ## Implementation ### 1. Teaser note in the WhatsApp band **File**: `src/components/landing/WhatsappCommunity.astro` Add an optional `directoryTeaser?: string` prop that defaults to the copy above. When the prop is non-empty, render it as a small note (for example `

`) under `.wa-lede` in the `wa-invite` column. Bold the lead-in phrase and use muted, smaller type than the lede. On phones it still reads before the How-to-join card. Update the header comment to explain why there is no number or link. ## Reused existing code - `WhatsappCommunity` from `src/components/landing/WhatsappCommunity.astro`, the band being extended - `isWhatsAppGroupLink` from `src/lib/localPresence.ts`, the rule the teaser respects by carrying no link ## Scenarios to Demonstrate - The homepage WhatsApp band showing the teaser, at desktop and phone widths - An isolated `WhatsappCommunity` with default props (teaser shown) - An isolated `WhatsappCommunity` with the teaser blanked (the band as it is today) Capture notes: the band is below the fold. Frame it with a `hover` interaction and `--target` the recapture.
description: The homepage WhatsApp band now teases the HIT Directory (beta) as a feature inside the community, without publishing its access number, keyword or a link, because the owner wants to announce it only as a reason to join for now. The band was reworked with the owner in the live preview into one column: the heading on one line, the lede, then a WhatsappJoinCard in the site's standard card style (crimson left rule) whose single larger 'Apply to join the community' button is the band's main action, then a quiet ink-coloured HitDirectoryTeaser that a null prop switches off. Scope verdict: all 7 project deliverables were already resolved, so this cycle delivered the plan's revised scope in full and deferred nothing; moving every WhatsApp join form to the new app's process stays out of scope until that process is ready. Also cleared inherited registry drift: 27 existing tests that ran but were unregistered are now registered.
